title: Arguments of `board.working` (Board work has started)
description: The `authz.object.args` of a live `board.working` action. Core sends it in the reply of the voice turn that queued a Board job, so the desktop can show that Jarvis is working. There is no "ended" action: the desktop ends the line itself when a panel arrives, when Jarvis next speaks unasked (the headline, or a sentence saying what went wrong), or after three minutes.
